ja: 『魔神英雄伝ワタル』より「龍王丸」がHGで登場！
■原作イメージに忠実なプロポーションの本体各所に可動ギミックを凝縮。
■内蔵された可動軸により、胸部両脇のブロックを前方へ引き出すことが可能。
■肩部アーマー内に組み込まれた軸可動により、腕の可動域が拡大。
■引き出された胸部両脇のブロックはフレキシブルに可動し、肩部関節の引き出し機構と合わせて、必殺技「鳳龍剣」のポーズを実現。剣を抜く仕草も自然に再現できる。
■腰部は引き出すことで股関節の可動域が拡大し、大胆なポージングが可能。
■肩アーマーの龍の模様もパーツ分割で表現。
■鳳龍剣に加え、鳳龍剣発動時の額パーツ、鞘盾（シースシールド）、ハンドパーツが付属。
■一部パーツ差し替えにより鳳王形態への再現が可能。
en: "Ryuomaru " from " Mashin Hero Wataru" appears in HG!
• Movable gimmicks are condensed in various parts of the body with proportions that are faithful to the original image.
• The built-in movable shaft allows the blocks on both sides of the chest to be pulled forward.
• Axial movement built into the shoulder armor expands the range of arm movement.

• The pulled-out blocks on both sides of the chest can be moved flexibly, and together with the pull-out mechanism of the shoulder joints, the pose of the special move "Horyuken" is realized. The gesture of drawing a sword can also be reproduced naturally.
• By pulling out the waist, the range of motion of the hip joints is expanded, allowing for bold poses.
• The dragon pattern on the shoulder armor is also expressed by dividing it into parts.
• In addition to the Horyuken, a forehead part, sheath shield, and hand parts for when the Horyuken is activated are included.
• Possible to recreate Houou form by replacing some parts.

ja: 鳳龍剣発動時の額パーツ×1
鳳王形態用差し替えパーツ×1式
en: Forehead part when activating Horyuken x1
Replacement parts for Houou form x 1 set
